text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser triumphs over Nice 
Nature at the Arima Kinen! After the race, 
the place the two of them headed was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At a ramen shop, Nice Nature was feeling 
down about her defeat, but the news 
playing on the store's TV praised her for 
running a great race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Emulating Matikanetannhauser's 'next time 
for sure,' she looked ahead. The two 
slurped their noodles together, readying 
themselves for the next battle.
